SELECT count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections WHERE state_epa_flag = 'E'
Where are SEC operating companies most often incorporated?
SELECT stateofincorporation, count(*) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE entitytype = 'operating' AND stateofincorporation <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many candidates won their general election in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2022' AND cast(gen_election AS varchar) = 'W'
Which age groups suffered the most traffic deaths in 2022?

SELECT CASE WHEN a < 16 THEN 'under 16' WHEN a < 25 THEN '16 to 24' WHEN a < 35 THEN '25 to 34' WHEN a < 45 THEN '35 to 44' WHEN a < 55 THEN '45 to 54' WHEN a < 65 THEN '55 to 64' WHEN a < 75 THEN '65 to 74' ELSE '75 and over' END AS age_group, count(*) AS killed FROM (SELECT try_cast(age AS integer) AS a FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022') WHERE a < 998 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademarks did the USPTO register in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS registrations FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE cast(registration_dt AS varchar) LIKE '2024%'
How are approved drug products most often given?
SELECT route, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE route IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the largest number of claims in one published application?
SELECT max(try_cast(pub_clm_ct AS double)) AS most_claims FROM govblock_patents.claims_pgpub_document_stats
Which kinds of drug targets does ChEMBL catalogue?
SELECT target_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_target_dictionary WHERE target_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
At what annual rate did real GDP shrink in the second quarter of 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS percent_change FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadataq WHERE seriescode = 'A191RL' AND period = '2020Q2'
What were the most common reasons lenders gave for turning down mortgages in 2010?

SELECT CASE trim(denial_reason_1) WHEN '1' THEN 'debt-to-income ratio' WHEN '2' THEN 'employment history' WHEN '3' THEN 'credit history' WHEN '4' THEN 'collateral' WHEN '5' THEN 'not enough cash' WHEN '6' THEN 'unverifiable information' WHEN '7' THEN 'incomplete application' WHEN '8' THEN 'mortgage insurance denied' ELSE 'other' END AS reason, count(*) AS denials FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar_2007_2017 WHERE cast(as_of_year AS varchar) = '2010' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3' AND trim(denial_reason_1) <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much revenue did New York's school districts take in during fiscal 2017?
SELECT sum(try_cast(totalrev AS double)) AS revenue FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' AND stabbr = 'NY' AND try_cast(totalrev AS double) > 0
Which countries' funders are acknowledged on the most PubMed papers?
SELECT country, count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_grants WHERE country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many nonprofits filed the short Form 990-EZ for tax year 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_990_index WHERE return_type = '990EZ' AND tax_period LIKE '2022%'
Which power plants have the biggest single generating units?

SELECT plant_name, state, technology, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS largest_unit_mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Ohio's 1992 presidential vote went to candidates outside the two major parties?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN party_simplified NOT IN ('DEMOCRAT', 'REPUBLICAN') THEN try_cast(candidatevotes AS double) ELSE 0 END) / sum(try_cast(candidatevotes AS double)), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.medsl_president_returns WHERE year = '1992' AND state_po = 'OH'
In which states do nursing homes receive the most health citations?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_healthcitations WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of applications were examined under the first-inventor-to-file rules of the America Invents Act?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(aia_first_to_file = 'Y') / count(*), 1) AS pct_first_to_file FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE aia_first_to_file IN ('Y', 'N')
Which conditions are studied in the most clinical trials?
SELECT condition, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_conditions WHERE condition IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published applications later became granted patents?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS granted FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_granted_pgpubs_crosswalk WHERE patent_id <> ''
Which states are federal contractors most often incorporated in?
SELECT state_of_incorporation, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many U.S. reactors are pressurised water and how many boiling water designs?
SELECT substr(reactor_and_containment_type, 1, 3) AS design, count(*) AS reactors FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which political organizations reported the most itemised contributions?
SELECT column03 AS organization, sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the Highway Trust Fund's balance on September 30, 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS balance FROM govblock_treasury.highway_trust_fund_results WHERE account_desc LIKE 'Balance Sept%30, 2024'
Which audit firms performed the most federal single audits for 2023?
SELECT auditor_firm_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year = '2023' AND auditor_firm_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent families does SureChEMBL cover?
SELECT count(DISTINCT family_id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents
Which states have the most colleges and universities?
SELECT stabbr, count(DISTINCT unitid) AS institutions FROM govblock_education.ipeds_hd GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules in the clinical toxicity set failed trials for toxicity?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_clintox WHERE ct_tox = 1
Which wind farms in Iowa have the largest number of turbines?
SELECT p_name, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'IA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many 10-K annual reports were filed with the SEC in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE form = '10-K' AND substr(cast(filed AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2023'
Which New York public schools have the most students?

SELECT sch_name, try_cast(student_count AS double) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' AND st = 'NY' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
